title: krateo-aws-ack-s3control
description: The ACK S3control service controller, wrapped for Krateo. Values are forwarded to the upstream s3control-chart chart. GENERATED by tools/ackgen — do not hand-edit.

ack.description: Forwarded verbatim to the upstream s3control-chart chart; keys not listed here keep the upstream default.

region.description: Default AWS region for this controller. Overridden per Composition by each blueprint's region field, which renders as the services.k8s.aws/region annotation.

endpoint_url.description: Non-default AWS endpoint (FIPS, VPC endpoint, localstack). Empty uses the public endpoints.

secretName.description: Secret holding a shared AWS credentials file. Leave empty when using IRSA / EKS Pod Identity.

secretKey.description: Key inside that Secret whose value is the credentials file.

profile.description: Profile to select from the credentials file.

annotations.description: IRSA / EKS Pod Identity wiring, e.g. eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn. The preferred credential path: no secret material enters the cluster.

installScope.description: cluster watches every namespace; namespace restricts the controller to watchNamespace.

watchNamespace.description: Only read when installScope is namespace. Empty means the release namespace.

deletionPolicy.description: delete destroys the real AWS resource when its Kubernetes resource is deleted; retain orphans it, leaving it running and billable.
